subject: Possible to set up a Google Summer of Code project regarding ODE solvers and rootfinding in Stan?

messages.author: bacb0402e67daa77
messages.subject: Possible to set up a Google Summer of Code project regarding ODE solvers and rootfinding in Stan?
parts:
Hi Stan team,

Would there be an avenue to pursuing a Google Summer of Code project related to Stan? I don't think you guys are on the list of mentoring organizations, but I would love to do something over the summer for the Stan project that would both be very educational for me and also very helpful to my own research. I'm starting to work with non-linear ODE systems now and need something like r's rootsolve package in Stan to avoid model spin-up to equilibrium.

The organization applications for GSoC are due on February 9th, so it might be too late already, but I just wanted to check in to see if Stan had any plans with Summer of Code. It could be a means of tackling some things on this page (https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/wiki/Complex-ODE-Based-Models) through various projects that otherwise are outside the focus of primary development.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Possible to set up a Google Summer of Code project regarding ODE solvers and rootfinding in Stan?
parts:
:-) We just discussed our plans for a root finder in today's
Stan meeting in order to find steady-state solutions to non-linear
ODEs. So that should be out soon, maybe even in the 2.15 release.

We are going to be participating in GSoC through NumFOCUS,
but so far only Krzysztof among the devs is willing to put
in the supervision NumFOCUS requests (5--10 hours/week). But
he's looking to add protocol buffer I/O.

Maybe Charles would be interested in supervising a GSoC project
on this---he's taking the lead in root finding these days? If
so, we only need to put in a pull request outlining the project
to NumFOCUS and it can go in. The relevant repo is here:

https://github.com/numfocus/gsoc

and the relevant file to copy and fill in is this one:

https://github.com/numfocus/gsoc/blob/master/2017/ideas-list-skeleton.md

- Bob
